title: glm-4v-9b lora报错ValueError: Processor was not found, please check and update your model file.
bodyExcerpt:
### Reminder

- [x] I have read the above rules and searched the existing issues.

### System Info

其中模型的yaml配置为：### model
model_name_or_path: /model/glm-4v-9b
image_max_pixels: 262144
video_max_pixels: 16384
trust_remote_code: true

### method
stage: sft
do_train: true
finetuning_type: lora
lora_rank: 8
lora_target: all

### dataset
dataset: alpaca_en_demo  # video: mllm_video_demo
template: glm4v
cutoff_len: 2048
max_samples: 1000
overwrite_cache: true
preprocessing_num_workers: 1
dataloader_num_workers: 1

### output
output_dir: saves/glm4v_9b/lora/sft
logging_steps: 10
save_steps: 500
plot_loss: true
overwrite_output_dir: true
save_only_model: false
report_to: none  # choices: [none, wandb, tensorboard, swanlab, mlflow]

### train
per_device_train_batch_size: 1
gradient_accumulation_steps: 8
learning_rate: 1.0e-4
num_train_epochs: 3.0
lr_scheduler_type: cosine
warmup_ratio: 0.1
bf16: true
ddp_timeout: 180000000
resume_from_checkpoint: null

### eval

# per_device_eval_batch_size: 1
# eval_strategy: steps
# eval_steps: 500
